name: 2D Thermal
description: Heat conduction in a sketch or a slice of a part, steady or changing with time (transient), in 2D: fixed temperatures, heat flux, heat generation in a region, a heat flow at a point, convection to a fluid, radiation to the surroundings and insulated edges (adiabatic or symmetry), a material for every region assigned in one table (about 25 built in, add your own), and optional heat loss from the two flat faces of a plate. Quadratic or linear triangles from gmsh; temperature and heat-flux pictures, an animation of the transient run, probe regions, a node probe, the heat flow through every condition and a heat balance that must close. Temperatures follow the unit system (metric: degC and W, US: degF and Btu). A .gph project folder with its own copy of the part; works with Parametric Studies. Material values are typical room-temperature numbers taken as constant; radiation goes to surroundings only (no view factors between parts).
